title: A day plate turned to night, with its sound
pitch: A daylight shot of a street in. The same shot at night, with night sound, side by side out.
why: Wan 2.2 makes the plate. LTX-2.5 with its day-to-night IC-LoRA relights the same move and writes new sound for it, so the night isn't a colour grade.

models.name: LTX-2.5
models.note: Accept the terms first; read them before commercial use.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: A slow, steady shot with lamps and windows in frame gives the night something to light.

steps.label: The day plate
steps.prompt: A quiet cobbled street in an old town on a sunny afternoon, shop windows, iron street lamps, a few pigeons on the cobbles, no people. The camera slowly pushes forward.

steps.label: The night
steps.does: The same shot at night, with night sound.
steps.scene: a quiet cobbled street in an old town with shop windows and iron street lamps

steps.label: Day and night
steps.does: Side by side, with the night's sound.
